mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( open_id, nick_name, avatar, phonenumber, password, login_ip, login_date , create_time, update_time) VALUES ( #{openid}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{phone}, #{password}, #{loginIp}, NOW() ,NOW(), #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE sys_user SET
password = #{password},
phonenumber = #{phone},
nick_name = #{nickname},
avatar = #{avatarUrl},
login_ip = #{loginIp},
login_date = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(sm.perms, '') as perms FROM sys_user_role sur left join sys_role sr on sur.role_id = sr.role_id left join sys_role_menu srm on sr.role_id = srm.role_id left join sys_menu sm on srm.menu_id = sm.menu_id WHERE user_id = #{userId}
